# Acme AI Platform

A production-ready, fully functional AI-powered platform with authentication, Stripe payments, real-time updates, database persistence and file uploads. It is tested and ready to ship.

## Roadmap

- [x] Authentication
- [x] Stripe payments
- [x] Real-time updates
- [x] AI chat
- [x] File uploads

See [the architecture](docs/architecture.md) and run `npm run e2e`.
